# terraform-api

aws_api_gateway_* and aws_lambda_function resources from HCL - interpolation becomes AF-TF-UNRESOLVED, never guessed.

## Recipes

- `apiforge model api-gateway --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge model asyncapi --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge model terraform --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge knowledge show terraform-api`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules (none declared)
